contract: Burning Swings 707632 reads 'Your Burning Blade now affects $s1 additional attacks.' Effect 0 is native aura 107 (SPELL_AURA_ADD_FLAT_MODIFIER), EffectMiscValue 4 -> SpellModOp::SPELLMOD_CHARGES (src/server/game/Spells/SpellDefines.h:80), EffectBasePoints 3 with DieSides 1 -> 4, EffectSpellClassMask [256,0,0] (all verified directly in the installed Spell.dbc). The affected spell is Burning Blade 524920 (the weapon-imbue buff with native ProcCharges 6, SPELL_AURA_PROC_TRIGGER_SPELL triggering the damage spell 524919, 'Lasts for $n attacks'): its own SpellFamilyFlags are {256,0,0}, confirmed directly in the installed Spell.dbc, which intersects Burning Swings' classMask exactly on dword0 bit 8. No script anywhere references 707632 or 524920 (repo-wide grep), consistent with a purely native spellmod passive. spell_modifier submits no cast; it reads the player's live ApplySpellMod(spell, op, value) result.
